indication: Rheumatoid arthritis (moderate-to-severe); psoriatic arthritis; ankylosing spondylitis; Crohn's disease (moderate-to-severe); ulcerative colitis (moderate-to-severe); plaque psoriasis (moderate-to-severe); juvenile idiopathic arthritis; uveitis

requiredSteps.description: For RA: Trial of at least two conventional DMARDs (methotrexate preferred, plus hydroxychloroquine, sulfasalazine, or leflunomide) at maximally tolerated doses, each for a minimum of 3 months. Documentation of inadequate response or intolerance required.

Preferred biosimilar adalimumab (e.g., Hadlima — Tier 4, adalimumab-bwwd) must be trialed before originator Humira (Tier 5) unless prescriber documents a clinical reason for branded preference. Biosimilar failure or intolerance required for Humira approval.

stepTherapyDetails.exceptions: Step therapy may be waived for: (1) severe or rapidly progressive disease requiring immediate biologic initiation per rheumatologist attestation; (2) documented failure of biosimilar within HealthBridge or another health plan within the prior 24 months; (3) clinical contraindication to biosimilar interchange.

quantityLimit: 2 prefilled syringes (40 mg each) per 28-day supply for standard RA dosing (every-other-week injection)
quantityLimitReason: Standard RA dose is 40 mg subcutaneous injection every other week. Quantities exceeding this require dose justification for Crohn's induction dosing or weekly RA dosing.
preferredSpecialtyPharmacy: HealthBridge Specialty Pharmacy (preferred) | CVS Specialty (preferred tier)
formularyNotes: Humira (adalimumab originator) is Tier 5 Non-Preferred. Preferred alternative: Hadlima (adalimumab-bwwd, Tier 4). Biosimilar preferred for new starts. Members stable on Humira who demonstrate clinical necessity may continue with PA renewal. Manufacturer copay assistance (AbbVie myAbbVie Assist) may be available — does not count toward OOP in IL for commercial plans.
clinicalAlerts: BOXED WARNING: Risk of serious infections including TB reactivation. Screen for latent TB with IGRA or PPD before initiation.
BOXED WARNING: Lymphoma and other malignancies reported in children and adolescents.
Monitor for hepatitis B reactivation in HBsAg+ or HBcAb+ patients
